title: SRE
description: Is the system healthy: feeds live, latency within budget, nothing dropped, recording keeping up.

panels.title: Service level: feed to engine (the trading path)
Feed → engine per region pair, last 5 min: p50, p99.99, max (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(labels['from'], ' → ', replaceOne(app, 'engine-', '')) AS route, round(sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6, 2) AS p50, round(sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6, 2) AS p99_99, round(max(max) / 1e6, 2) AS max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND name = 'md_to_engine_ns' GROUP BY route ORDER BY route

panels.description: Same region: Aeron on the node. Across regions: the network. Count-weighted averages of each 5 s window's estimated percentiles (not percentiles of all samples combined); min and max are exact. Cross-node values use both nodes' wall clocks.

panels.title: Feed → engine latency per region pair (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(labels['from'], ' → ', replaceOne(app, 'engine-', '')) AS route, round(min(min) / 1e6, 3) AS min, round(sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6, 3) AS p50, round(sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6, 3) AS p99, round(sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6, 3) AS p99_99, round(max(max) / 1e6, 3) AS max, sum(count) AS samples FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'md_to_engine_ns' GROUP BY route ORDER BY route

panels.description: Count-weighted averages of each 5 s window's estimated percentiles (not percentiles of all samples combined); min and max are exact. Cross-node values use both nodes' wall clocks.

panels.title: Feeds
Feed live on each engine (1 live, 0 replaying or lost)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'engine-', ''), ' ', labels['venue']) AS series, min(value) AS live FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'feed_live' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Book age by venue, worst engine (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['venue'] AS venue, max(value) / 1e6 AS age_ms FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'book_age_ns' GROUP BY time, venue ORDER BY time

panels.description: Time since an engine last applied this venue's book. A stalled feed climbs here first.

panels.title: Messages per second by feed

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['kind']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'messages' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Feed resyncs and replayed messages / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'engine-', ''), ' ', labels['venue'], ' ', name) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name IN ('feed_resyncs', 'feed_replayed') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Loss and back pressure
Dropped records / s by app and reason

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['reason']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'persist_dropped' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: A record the application could not publish: back_pressure (Aeron log full: the archive or a subscriber behind), not_connected, too_large. Should be zero.

panels.title: Publisher headroom before back pressure (bytes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.ts AS time, concat(p.host, ' ', toString(p.stream_id), ' ', p.client_name) AS publication, min(l.value - p.value) AS headroom FROM metrics.aeron_counters AS p INNER JOIN metrics.aeron_counters AS l ON p.ts = l.ts AND p.registration_id = l.registration_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.type = 'pub-pos' AND l.type = 'pub-lmt' GROUP BY time, publication ORDER BY time

panels.title: Archive behind publisher (bytes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.ts AS time, concat(p.host, ' recording ', toString(r.recording_id)) AS recording, max(p.value - r.value) AS behind FROM metrics.aeron_counters AS p INNER JOIN metrics.aeron_counters AS r ON p.ts = r.ts AND p.session_id = r.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.type = 'pub-pos' AND r.type = 'rec-pos' GROUP BY time, recording ORDER BY time

panels.title: NAKs, retransmits and loss per node / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(host, ' ', label) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.aeron_counters WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type = 'system' AND label IN ('NAKs sent', 'NAKs received', 'Retransmits sent', 'Loss gap fills') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recording to ClickHouse (off the trading path)
Ingest lag: feed handler receive → row in ClickHouse by node: min, p50, p99, p99.99, max (s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(inserted_at) AS time, host, min(dateDiff('millisecond', ts_init, inserted_at)) / 1000 AS min, quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', ts_init, inserted_at)) / 1000 AS p50, quantile(0.99)(dateDiff('millisecond', ts_init, inserted_at)) / 1000 AS p99, quantile(0.9999)(dateDiff('millisecond', ts_init, inserted_at)) / 1000 AS p99_99, max(dateDiff('millisecond', ts_init, inserted_at)) / 1000 AS max FROM md.quote WHERE $__timeFilter(inserted_at) GROUP BY time, host ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rows inserted per second by table

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, database || '.' || table AS t, sum(rows) / $__interval_s AS rows FROM system.part_log WHERE database IN ('md', 'engine', 'orders', 'tracing', 'metrics') AND event_type = 'NewPart' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time, t ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active parts per table (merge pressure)

targets.rawSql: SELECT database || '.' || table AS t, count() AS parts, sum(rows) AS rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS size FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database IN ('md', 'engine', 'orders', 'tracing', 'metrics') GROUP BY t ORDER BY parts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Failed ClickHouse queries (last hour)

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(event_time) AS last, count() AS n, any(substring(exception, 1, 160)) AS error FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing') GROUP BY exception_code ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Trading health
Open, expired and stale orders

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', name) AS series, max(value) AS n FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name IN ('orders_open', 'orders_expired', 'orders_stale') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine clock drift (wall − monotonic, µs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, app, avg(value) / 1e3 AS drift_us FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'clock_drift_ns' GROUP BY time, app ORDER BY time

panels.description: How far each engine's wall clock wanders from its monotonic clock; cross-node latencies are only as good as this.
